i: I means used of a single unit or thing.
I can also mean a nonmetallic element belonging to the halogens.
I can also mean the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.
I means the same as one or 1 or ane.
i-beam: I-beam is girder having a cross section resembling the letter `I'.
i. a. richards: I. A. Richards is English literary critic who collaborated with C. K. Ogden and contributed to the development of Basic English.
I. A. Richards means the same as Richards or Ivor Armstrong Richards.
i. f. stone: I. F. Stone is United States journalist who advocated liberal causes.
I. F. Stone means the same as Stone or Isidor Feinstein Stone.
i. m. pei: I. M. Pei is United States architect.
I. M. Pei means the same as Pei or Ieoh Ming Pei.
I.D. is a card or badge used to identify the bearer.
For example: "You had to show your ID in order to get in."
I.D. means the same as ID.
I.E.D. is an explosive device that is improvised.
I.E.D. means the same as improvised explosive device or IED.
I.O.C. is organization responsible for organizing the modern Olympic Games.
I.O.C. means the same as International Olympic Committee or IOC.
I.Q. is a measure of a person's intelligence as indicated by an intelligence test.
I.Q. means the same as intelligence quotient or IQ.
I.W.W. is a former international labor union and radical labor movement in the United States.
I.W.W. means the same as Industrial Workers of the World or IWW.
i chronicles: I Chronicles is the first of two Old Testament books telling the history of Judah and Israel until the return from the Babylonian Captivity in 536 BC.
I Chronicles means the same as 1 Chronicles.
i corinthians: I Corinthians is a New Testament book containing the first epistle from Saint Paul to the church at Corinth.
I Corinthians means the same as First Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Corinthians or First Epistle to the Corinthians.
i esdra: I Esdra is an Apocryphal book consisting of a compilation from I Chronicles and II Chronicles and Ezra and Nehemiah.
I Esdra means the same as 1 Esdras.
i john: I John is the first New Testament epistle traditionally attributed to Saint John the Apostle.
I John means the same as First Epistle of John.
i kings: I Kings is the first of two Old Testament books telling the histories of the kings of Judah and Israel.
I Kings means the same as 1 Kings.
i maccabees: I Maccabees is an Apocryphal book describing the life of Judas Maccabaeus.
I Maccabees means the same as 1 Maccabees.
i peter: I Peter is the first New Testament book traditionally attributed to Saint Peter the Apostle.
I Peter means the same as First Epistle of Peter.
i samuel: I Samuel is the first of two books in the Old Testament that tell of Saul and David.
I Samuel means the same as 1 Samuel.
i thessalonians: I Thessalonians is a New Testament book containing Saint Paul's first epistle to the Thessalonians.
I Thessalonians means the same as First Epistle of Paul the Apostle to the Thessalonians or First Epistle to the Thessalonians.
i timothy: I Timothy is a New Testament book containing Saint Paul's first epistle to Timothy.
I Timothy means the same as First Epistle of Paul the Apostle to Timothy or First Epistle to Timothy.
I.e. means that is to say.
I.e. means the same as ie or id est.
